newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BOS Australia issues A$50 mln MTN.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BOS Australia issues A$50 mln MTN.

text.p: BOS International (Australia) Ltd, the first issuer to establish a combined commercial paper and medium term note (MTN) programme in the Australian market, has issued A$50 million fixed rate MTNs in its maiden MTN issue from the programme, Westpac Banking Corp said.
Previously, the company had only utilised the commercial paper component of the programme to raise funds, Westpac said.
The programme size was recently increased to A$1 billion from A$750 million.
The issue carries a fixed rate coupon and matures in November 2001. It was issued to investors to yield a margin of 31 basis points over the corresponding government bond.
The issue represented the second domestic MTN for the year following last week's A$150 million April 2000 issue for Banque Nationale de Paris' Australian branch, also arranged by Westpac.

The bank said the issue established the first November 2001 corporate benchmark. The MTNs issued under the programe are guaranteed by the Bank of Scotland. They have been assigned a long term debt rating of A-plus by Standard and Poor's.
